subject.title: fix(bug): Google Chat stale approval cards keep retrying after approv…

question: After real behavior proof is added, which Google Chat stale approval-card fix branch should maintainers treat as canonical?
rationale: Two open PRs implement the same narrow handler fix, and automation should not choose between contributor branches without maintainer intent once proof is available.

options.title: Use the first proof-positive clean branch
options.body: Merge this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98433 only after it has redacted real Google Chat proof, current-head green checks, and no duplicate diff drift.

options.title: Prefer the issue-linked draft
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98433 to leave draft and provide proof if maintainers prefer the branch that closes the canonical issue directly.

options.title: Replace both branches
options.body: Close both contributor branches and land a maintainer-owned equivalent if current-main drift or proof gaps make adoption more expensive than a fresh narrow fix.

recommendation.title: Use the first proof-positive clean branch
recommendation.body: Merge this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98433 only after it has redacted real Google Chat proof, current-head green checks, and no duplicate diff drift.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the Google Chat native approval-card surface introduced by this owner path.
